sentences.zh: 廣順元年春二月癸巳朔，以樞密副使、尚書戶部侍郎範質為兵部侍郎，依前充職；

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangshun, spring, second month, on guisi, the first day of the month, Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of Revenue in the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of War, continuing in his previous concurrent appointment;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the first day of the second month of spring in the first year of Guangshun, Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue in the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of War while retaining his previous concurrent post;

sentences.zh: 以陳州刺史、判三司李穀為戶部侍郎，判三司；

translations.literal: Li Gu, Prefect of Chen Prefecture and Administrator of the Three Departments, was made Vice Minister of Revenue, administering the Three Departments;
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu, Prefect of Chen Prefecture and Administrator of the Three Departments, was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue and continued to administer the Three Departments;

sentences.zh: 以右金吾大將軍、充街使翟光鄴為左千牛衛上將軍，充宣徽北院使；

translations.literal: Zhai Guangye, Grand General of the Right Golden Awesome Guard and Street Commissioner, was made Senior General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard, serving as Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Guangye, Grand General of the Right Golden Awesome Guard and Street Commissioner, was appointed Senior General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使袁鳷為左武衛上將軍，充宣徽南院使；

translations.literal: Yuan Zhi, Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat, was made Senior General of the Left Martial Guard, serving as Commissioner of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhi, Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed Senior General of the Left Martial Guard and Commissioner of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以左右金吾大將軍、充街使符彥琳為右監門上將軍。

translations.literal: Fu Yanlin, Grand General of the Left and Right Golden Awesome Guards and Street Commissioner, was made Senior General of the Right Gate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanlin, Grand General of the Left and Right Golden Awesome Guards and Street Commissioner, was appointed Senior General of the Right Gate Guard.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以皇子天雄軍牙內都指揮使、檢校右僕射、貴州刺史榮起復為澶州節度使、檢校太保，以右金吾上將軍薛可言為右龍武統軍，以左神武統軍安審約為左羽林統軍，以左驍衛上將軍趙贊為右羽林統軍，以太子太師致仕宋彥筠為左衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the imperial son Rong, Vice Director-in-Chief of the Tianxiong Army's Inner Guard, Inspector-General of the Right Vice-Director, and Prefect of Gui Prefecture, was reinstated as Military Commissioner of Chan Prefecture and Inspector-General of the Grand Guardian; Xue Keyan as Grand Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard; An Shenyue as Grand Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Zhao Zan as Grand Commander of the Right Feathered Forest Guard; Song Yanjun, retired Grand Master of the Crown Prince, as Senior General of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Emperor's son Rong, Vice Director-in-Chief of the Tianxiong Army's Inner Guard, Inspector-General of the Right Vice-Director, and Prefect of Gui Prefecture, was reinstated as Military Commissioner of Chan Prefecture and Inspector-General of the Grand Guardian; Xue Keyan was made Grand Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Guard; An Shenyue, Grand Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard, was transferred to Grand Commander of the Left Feathered Forest Guard; Zhao Zan, Senior General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard, was made Grand Commander of the Right Feathered Forest Guard; and Song Yanjun, retired Grand Master of the Crown Prince, was appointed Senior General of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 詔移生吐渾族帳於潞州長子縣江豬嶺。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relocation of the living Tuyuhun tribal encampments to Jiangzhu Ridge in Changzi County, Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the living Tuyuhun tribal encampments moved to Jiangzhu Ridge in Changzi County, Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以左武衛上將軍劉遂凝為左神武統軍，以左衛上將軍焦繼勛為右神武統軍，以左領軍衛上將軍史佺為右衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On jihai, Liu Ningning, Senior General of the Left Martial Guard, was made Grand Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, Senior General of the Left Guard, was made Grand Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard; Shi Quan, Senior General of the Left Leading Army Guard, was made Senior General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liu Ningning, Senior General of the Left Martial Guard, was appointed Grand Commander of the Left Divine Martial Guard; Jiao Jixun, Senior General of the Left Guard, was made Grand Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard; and Shi Quan, Senior General of the Left Leading Army Guard, was appointed Senior General of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚子，故吳國夫人張氏追贈貴妃；

translations.literal: On gengzi, the late Lady of Wu, Zhang, was posthumously enfeoffed as Noble Consort;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the late Lady of Wu, née Zhang, was posthumously enfeoffed as Noble Consort;

sentences.zh: 故皇第三女追封樂安公主；

translations.literal: the late third imperial daughter was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Le'an;
translations.idiomatic: the late third imperial daughter was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Le'an;

sentences.zh: 故第二子青哥贈太保，賜名侗；

translations.literal: the late second son Qingge was posthumously made Grand Guardian and granted the name Tong;
translations.idiomatic: the late second son Qingge was posthumously made Grand Guardian and given the name Tong;

sentences.zh: 第三子意哥贈司空，賜名信；

translations.literal: the third son Yige was posthumously made Minister of Works and granted the name Xin;
translations.idiomatic: the third son Yige was posthumously made Minister of Works and given the name Xin;

sentences.zh: 故長婦劉氏追封彭城郡夫人。

translations.literal: the late eldest daughter-in-law, née Liu, was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of Pengcheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: the late eldest daughter-in-law, née Liu, was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of Pengcheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 皇侄三人：守筠贈左領軍將軍，改名願；

translations.literal: Three imperial nephews: Shoujun was posthumously made General of the Left Leading Army Guard and renamed Yuan;
translations.idiomatic: Three imperial nephews: Shoujun was posthumously made General of the Left Leading Army Guard and renamed Yuan;

sentences.zh: 奉超贈左監門將軍；

translations.literal: Fengchao was posthumously made General of the Left Gate Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Fengchao was posthumously made General of the Left Gate Guard;

sentences.zh: 定哥贈左千牛衛將軍，賜名遜。

translations.literal: Dingge was posthumously made General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and granted the name Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Dingge was posthumously made General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and given the name Xun.

sentences.zh: 故皇孫三人：宜哥贈左驍衛大將軍，賜名誼；

translations.literal: Three late imperial grandsons: Yige was posthumously made Grand General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard and granted the name Yi;
translations.idiomatic: Three late imperial grandsons: Yige was posthumously made Grand General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard and given the name Yi;

sentences.zh: 喜哥贈武衛大將軍，賜名誠；

translations.literal: Xige was posthumously made Grand General of the Martial Guard and granted the name Cheng;
translations.idiomatic: Xige was posthumously made Grand General of the Martial Guard and given the name Cheng;

sentences.zh: 三哥贈左領衛大將軍，賜名諴。

translations.literal: Sange was posthumously made Grand General of the Left Leading Guard and granted the name Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Sange was posthumously made Grand General of the Left Leading Guard and given the name Shan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，西州回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Uighurs of Xizhou sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Uighurs of Xizhou sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 前開封尹、魯國公侯益進封楚國公，前西京留守、莒國公李從敏進封秦國公，前西京留守王守恩進封莒國公。

translations.literal: The former Prefect of Kaifeng and Duke of Lu, Hou Yi, was advanced to Duke of Chu; the former Western Capital Military Commissioner and Duke of Ju, Li Congmin, was advanced to Duke of Qin; the former Western Capital Military Commissioner Wang Shou'en was advanced to Duke of Ju.
translations.idiomatic: The former Prefect of Kaifeng and Duke of Lu, Hou Yi, was promoted to Duke of Chu; the former Western Capital Military Commissioner and Duke of Ju, Li Congmin, was promoted to Duke of Qin; and the former Western Capital Military Commissioner Wang Shou'en was promoted to Duke of Ju.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事李濤為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On guimao, the former Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Associate Counselor Li Tao was made Guest of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Tao, former Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Associate Counselor, was appointed Guest of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 詔宣徽南院使袁鳷權知開封府事，以太子太保和凝為太子太傅。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Yuan Zhi, Commissioner of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat, to act as Prefect of Kaifeng; He Ning, Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince, was made Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Yuan Zhi, Commissioner of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat, acting Prefect of Kaifeng, and made He Ning, Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince, Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 丙午，晉州王晏奏，河東劉崇遣偽招討使劉鈞、副招討使白截海，率步騎萬餘人來攻州城，以今月五日五道齊攻，率州兵拒之，賊軍傷死甚眾。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Wang Yan of Jin Prefecture reported that Liu Chong of Hedong had sent the false Pacification Commissioner Liu Jun and Vice Pacification Commissioner Bai Jiehai, leading more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry to attack the prefectural city; on the fifth of this month they attacked together from five routes, and he led the prefectural troops to resist them; the rebel army suffered very many killed and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wang Yan of Jin Prefecture reported that Liu Chong of Hedong had sent the rebel Pacification Commissioner Liu Jun and Vice Pacification Commissioner Bai Jiehai at the head of more than ten thousand foot and horse soldiers to assault the prefectural city. On the fifth of this month the enemy advanced in five columns at once; Yan led the prefectural troops to resist, and the rebel force suffered heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·王晏傳》：劉崇侵晉州，晏閉關不出，設伏城上。

translations.literal: (From the 《Biography of Wang Yan》 in the 《History of Song》: When Liu Chong invaded Jin Prefecture, Yan closed the passes and did not go out, setting ambushes atop the walls.
translations.idiomatic: (From the 《Biography of Wang Yan》 in the 《History of Song》: When Liu Chong invaded Jin Prefecture, Yan kept the gates shut and refused to sally forth, but set ambushes along the ramparts.

sentences.zh: 並人以為怯，競攀堞而登，晏麾伏兵擊之，顛死者甚眾，遂焚橋遁。

translations.literal: The Bing people all thought him cowardly and competed to climb the parapets and ascend; Yan waved his hidden troops to strike them, and very many fell headlong to their deaths; then they burned the bridge and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Bing troops took this for cowardice and scrambled up the battlements. Yan signaled his hidden troops to strike; a great many fell headlong to their deaths. The enemy then burned the bridge and fled.

sentences.zh: 晏遣子漢倫追北數十里，斬首百餘級。）〉

translations.literal: Yan sent his son Hanlun in pursuit north for several tens of li and beheaded more than a hundred.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Yan sent his son Hanlun in pursuit for several tens of li to the north and took more than a hundred heads.)

sentences.zh: 內出寶玉器及金銀結縷、寶裝床幾、飲食之具數十，碎之於殿庭。

translations.literal: From within were brought out several tens of precious jades and vessels, gold and silver knotted threads, treasure-mounted beds and tables, and dining implements, and they were smashed in the palace courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Several dozen pieces of precious jade ware, gold and silver cordwork, treasure-mounted beds and tables, and dining implements were brought out from the inner palace and smashed in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 帝謂侍臣曰：「凡為帝王，安用此！

translations.literal: The Emperor said to his attending ministers: "For anyone who is an emperor, what use is this!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said to his attending ministers, "What need has an emperor for such things!

sentences.zh: 」仍詔所司，凡珍華悅目之物，不得入宮。

translations.literal: " He also ordered the responsible offices that all rare and splendid objects pleasing to the eye were not to be brought into the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " He also ordered the responsible offices that no rare or splendid objects meant merely to please the eye were to be brought into the palace.

sentences.zh: 先是，回鶻間歲入貢，禁民不得與蕃人市易寶貨，至是一聽私便交易，官不禁詰。

translations.literal: Previously, the Uighurs had presented tribute every other year, and the people were forbidden to trade precious goods with the foreigners; from this time private trade was entirely permitted, and the government did not prohibit or investigate it.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Uighurs had sent tribute every other year, and commoners had been forbidden to trade precious goods with the foreigners. From this time onward private trade was freely permitted, and the government neither prohibited nor investigated it.

sentences.zh: 丁未，左千牛將軍朱憲使契丹回。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Zhu Xian, General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard, returned from his mission to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Zhu Xian, General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard, returned from his mission to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 契丹主烏裕遣使郭濟獻良馬一駟，賀登極。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent the envoy Guo Ji presenting a team of four fine horses to congratulate him on ascending the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent the envoy Guo Ji with a team of four fine horses to congratulate the Emperor on his accession.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「朕祗膺景命，奄有中區，每思順物之情，從眾之欲。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict said: "We respectfully received the luminous mandate and suddenly hold the central realm; we constantly think to follow the disposition of things and comply with the people's desires.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, an edict said, "We have respectfully received Heaven's luminous mandate and now hold the central realm. We constantly seek to follow the natural disposition of affairs and heed the people's wishes.

sentences.zh: 將使照臨之下，多寄食僦舍之徒；

translations.literal: We wish that under Our illumination there should not be many persons lodging and renting rooms;
translations.idiomatic: We do not wish those under Our rule to be left as so many boarders renting rooms far from home;

sentences.zh: 歲月之間，動懷土念家之思。

translations.literal: through the months and years, constantly moved by thoughts of native soil and longing for home.
translations.idiomatic: year after year haunted by thoughts of native soil and homes left behind.

sentences.zh: 宜循大體，用革前規。

translations.literal: It is fitting to follow the great principle and use this to reform the former regulations.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to follow the larger principle and reform the former regulations accordingly.

sentences.zh: 應諸道州府，有前資朝官居住，如未赴京，不得發遣。

translations.literal: In all circuits and prefectures, where former qualified court officials reside, if they have not yet gone to the capital, they shall not be sent away.
translations.idiomatic: In all circuits and prefectures, former qualified court officials who are residing locally shall not be sent away if they have not yet reported to the capital.

sentences.zh: 其行軍副使已下，幕職州縣官等，得替求官，自有月限，年月未滿，一聽外居。

translations.literal: As for military vice commissioners and below, secretariat staff, and prefectural and county officials, when relieved and seeking new appointments, they have their own monthly limits; if the months and years are not yet complete, they are entirely permitted to reside outside.
translations.idiomatic: As for military vice commissioners and below, secretariat staff, and prefectural and county officials who have been relieved and are seeking new appointments, each has a fixed term of months; until that term is complete, they may all reside outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 如非時詔征，不在此限。

translations.literal: If there is an extraordinary edict summoning them, this limit does not apply.
translations.idiomatic: This limit does not apply when they are summoned by extraordinary edict.

sentences.zh: 」己酉，有司議立四親廟，從之。

translations.literal: " On jiyou, the responsible offices discussed establishing temples to the four close ancestors, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiyou, the responsible offices proposed establishing temples to the four close ancestors, and the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以太子少傅楊凝式為太子少師，以太常卿張昭為戶部尚書，以尚書左丞王易為禮部尚書，以兵部侍郎邊蔚為太常卿，以翰林學士、中書舍人魚崇諒為工部侍郎充職，以戶部侍郎韋勛為兵部侍郎，以刑部侍郎邊歸讜為戶部侍郎，以禮部侍郎司徒詡為刑部侍郎，以秘書監趙上交為禮部侍郎，以兵部尚書王仁裕為太子少保，以翰林學士、禮部尚書張沆為刑部尚書充職，以尚書右丞田敏為左丞，以吏部侍郎段希堯為工部尚書，以太子詹事馬裔孫為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Yang Ningshi, Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Zhang Zhao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Minister of Revenue; Wang Yi, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Minister of Rites; Bian Wei, Vice Minister of War, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Yu Chongliang, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works in concurrent service; Wei Xun, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War; Bian Guican, Vice Minister of Punishments, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Situ Xu, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Punishments; Zhao Shangjiao, Director of the Secretariat Archive, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Wang Renyu, Minister of War, was made Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince; Zhang Hong, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Punishments in concurrent service; Tian Min, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director; Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Minister of Works; Ma Yisun, Steward of the Crown Prince's Household, was made Guest of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Yang Ningshi, Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, was appointed Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Zhang Zhao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Minister of Revenue; Wang Yi, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Minister of Rites; Bian Wei, Vice Minister of War, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Yu Chongliang, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was appointed Vice Minister of Works while retaining his concurrent post; Wei Xun, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War; Bian Guican, Vice Minister of Punishments, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Situ Xu, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Punishments; Zhao Shangjiao, Director of the Secretariat Archive, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Wang Renyu, Minister of War, was appointed Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince; Zhang Hong, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Punishments while retaining his concurrent post; Tian Min, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was transferred to Left Vice Director; Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Minister of Works; and Ma Yisun, Steward of the Crown Prince's Household, was appointed Guest of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 前鄜州節度使劉重進、前滑州節度使宋延渥，並加食邑。

translations.literal: The former Military Commissioner of Fu Prefecture Liu Chongjin and the former Military Commissioner of Hua Prefecture Song Yanwo both received additions to their fief income.
translations.idiomatic: The former Military Commissioner of Fu Prefecture Liu Chongjin and the former Military Commissioner of Hua Prefecture Song Yanwo both received increases to their fief income.

sentences.zh: 吐渾府留後王全德加檢校太保，充憲州刺史。

translations.literal: Wang Quande, Military Governor-in-Residence of the Tuyuhun Prefecture, was made Inspector-General of the Grand Guardian and appointed Prefect of Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quande, Military Governor-in-Residence of the Tuyuhun Prefecture, was made Inspector-General of the Grand Guardian and appointed Prefect of Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隰州刺史許遷奏，河東賊軍劉筠自晉州引兵來攻州城，尋以州兵拒之，賊軍傷死者五百人，信宿遁去。

translations.literal: Xu Qian, Prefect of Xi Prefecture, reported that the Hedong rebel army under Liu Jun had led troops from Jin Prefecture to attack the prefectural city; shortly afterward he led the prefectural troops to resist them; the rebel army had five hundred killed and wounded; after one night they fled away.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qian, Prefect of Xi Prefecture, reported that the Hedong rebel force under Liu Jun had marched from Jin Prefecture to assault the prefectural city. He soon led the prefectural troops to resist; the rebels suffered five hundred killed and wounded and withdrew after a night.

sentences.zh: 丁已，以尚書左丞田敏充契丹國信使。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was appointed envoy bearing the national credence to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was appointed credentialed envoy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: The Uighurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The Uighurs sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 己未，天德軍節度使、虢國公郭勛加同平章事，以前宗正卿劉皞為衛尉卿。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Guo Xun, Military Commissioner of the Tiande Army and Duke of Guo, was made Associate Counselor; the former Director of the Imperial Clan Court Liu Hao was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Guo Xun, Military Commissioner of the Tiande Army and Duke of Guo, was made Associate Counselor; and the former Director of the Imperial Clan Court Liu Hao was appointed Director of the Court of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以衛尉卿邊光範為秘書監，以前吏部侍郎李詳為吏部侍郎，以前戶部侍郎顏衎為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Bian Guangfan, Director of the Court of the Imperial Guard, was made Director of the Secretariat Archive; Li Xiang, former Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Yan Kan, former Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Bian Guangfan, Director of the Court of the Imperial Guard, was appointed Director of the Secretariat Archive; Li Xiang, former Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Vice Minister of Personnel; and Yan Kan, former Vice Minister of Revenue, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌朔，前西京留守李從敏卒。

translations.literal: Third month, on renxu, the first day of the month, the former Western Capital Military Commissioner Li Congmin died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the first day of the third month, the former Western Capital Military Commissioner Li Congmin died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前左武衛上將軍李懷忠為太子太傅致仕，以前邢州節度使安審暉為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Li Huaizhong, former Senior General of the Left Martial Guard, was made retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; An Shenhui, former Military Commissioner of Xing Prefecture, was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Li Huaizhong, former Senior General of the Left Martial Guard, was granted retirement as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; and An Shenhui, former Military Commissioner of Xing Prefecture, was granted retirement as Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸南莊。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the Emperor visited the Southern Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Emperor visited the Southern Estate.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔曰：「諸州府先差散從親事官等，前朝創置，蓋出權宜，茍便一時，本非舊貫。

translations.literal: On renshen, an edict said: "The various prefectures and circuits previously dispatched scattered attendant and personal-affairs officials and the like; the former dynasty created these posts, which arose from expediency and were merely convenient for a time, and were not originally part of established practice.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, an edict said, "The various prefectures and circuits had previously been required to dispatch scattered attendant and personal-affairs officials and the like. The former dynasty had created these posts as an expedient measure convenient for the moment, not as part of long-established practice.

sentences.zh: 近者遍詢群議，兼采封章，且言前件抽差，於理不甚允當，一則礙州縣之色役，一則妨春夏之耕耘，貧乏者困於供須，豪富者幸於影庇，既為煩擾，須至改更，況當東作之時，宜罷不急之務。

translations.literal: Recently we have broadly inquired of collective opinion and also collected memorials, all saying that the previous practice of requisitioning such personnel was not very reasonable in principle: on the one hand it obstructed the corvée duties of prefectures and counties, on the other it hindered spring and summer plowing and hoeing; the poor were distressed by supplying provisions, while the wealthy profited from concealed protection; since it was troublesome and disturbing, it must be changed; moreover, since it is the season of eastern work, it is fitting to stop non-urgent tasks.
translations.idiomatic: Recently we have consulted widely and reviewed memorials, all of which say that requisitioning such personnel was not reasonable in principle: it obstructed the corvée duties of prefectures and counties on the one hand and hindered spring and summer farming on the other. The poor were burdened with supplying provisions while the wealthy profited from concealed protection. Since the practice was burdensome and disruptive, it must be changed. Moreover, this is the season for spring planting; non-urgent tasks should be suspended.

sentences.zh: 其諸州所差散從親事官等，並宜放散。

translations.literal: All scattered attendant and personal-affairs officials and the like dispatched by the various prefectures should be released and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: All scattered attendant and personal-affairs officials and the like dispatched by the various prefectures should be released and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 」詔下，公私便之。

translations.literal: " When the edict was issued, it was convenient for both public and private interests.
translations.idiomatic: " When the edict was issued, it brought relief to both government and populace.

sentences.zh: 徐州行營都部署王彥超馳奏，收復徐州。

translations.literal: Wang Yanchao, Commander-in-Chief of the Xuzhou Field Headquarters, sent an urgent report that Xuzhou had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanchao, Commander-in-Chief of the Xuzhou Field Headquarters, sent an urgent report that Xuzhou had been recovered.

sentences.zh: 「城內逆首楊溫及親近徒黨並處斬。

translations.literal: "The rebel leader Yang Wen within the city and his close followers were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: "The rebel leader Yang Wen within the city and his close followers were all executed.

sentences.zh: 其餘無名目人及本城軍都將校、職掌吏民等，雖被脅從，本非同惡，並釋放。

translations.literal: The rest, persons without formal status and the city's military commanders, officers, clerks, and commoners, although coerced to follow, were not originally of the same evil intent, and were all released.
translations.idiomatic: All others without formal status, together with the city's military commanders, officers, clerks, and commoners, though coerced into participation, had not originally shared the rebels' intent and were all released.

sentences.zh: 兼知自前楊溫招喚草賊，同力守把，朕以村墅小民，偶被扇誘，念其庸賤，特與含容，其招入城草賊，並放歸農，仍倍加安撫。

translations.literal: We also know that previously Yang Wen had summoned bandits from the wilds to join in holding the defenses together; We regard these village and hamlet commoners as having been incidentally incited and seduced; considering their low and mean status, We especially grant them forbearance; all wild bandits summoned into the city are to be released back to farming, and are to receive doubled reassurance and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: We also know that Yang Wen had earlier summoned rural bandits to help hold the city. We regard these village folk as having been incidentally incited; considering their low station, We especially grant them forbearance. All rural bandits who had been drawn into the city are to be released back to farming and given redoubled reassurance.

sentences.zh: 湘陰公夫人並骨肉在彼，仰差人安撫守護，勿令驚恐。

translations.literal: The Lady of Xiangyin and her kin who are there—send persons to reassure and protect them, and do not let them be frightened.
translations.idiomatic: The Lady of Xiangyin and her kin who are there should be reassured and protected by dispatched officials so that they are not frightened.

sentences.zh: 」以右散騎常侍張煦、給事中王延藹並為左散騎常侍，以前大名府少尹李瓊為將作監，以前彰武軍節度使周密為太子太師致仕，以衛尉卿劉皞充漢隱帝山陵部署。

translations.literal: " Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Attendant Drafting Edicts, were both made Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; Li Qiong, former Junior Prefect of Daming Prefecture, was made Director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction; Zhou Mi, former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army, was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Liu Hao, Director of the Court of the Imperial Guard, was appointed to the Han Hidden Emperor's mausoleum deployment.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Attendant Drafting Edicts, were both appointed Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; Li Qiong, former Junior Prefect of Daming Prefecture, was made Director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction; Zhou Mi, former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army, was granted retirement as Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince; and Liu Hao, Director of the Court of the Imperial Guard, was appointed to oversee the Han Hidden Emperor's mausoleum works.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以太子少保致仕王延為太子少傅，以戶部尚書致仕盧損、左驍衛上將軍致仕李肅並為太子少保，兵部尚書致仕韓昭允為尚書右僕射，太子太師致仕盧文紀為司空。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Wang Yan, retired Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, was made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Lu Sun, retired Minister of Revenue, and Li Su, retired Senior General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard, were both made Junior Guardians of the Crown Prince; Han Zhaoyun, retired Minister of War, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Lu Wenji, retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Wang Yan, retired Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, was appointed Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Lu Sun, retired Minister of Revenue, and Li Su, retired Senior General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard, were both made Junior Guardians of the Crown Prince; Han Zhaoyun, retired Minister of War, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; and Lu Wenji, retired Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 自延而下，並依前致仕。

translations.literal: From Yan downward, all continued in their former retirement status.
translations.idiomatic: From Yan downward, all continued in retirement as before.

sentences.zh: 故散騎常侍裴羽贈戶部尚書，故太子賓客蕭願贈禮部尚書，以司農卿致仕薛仁謙為鴻臚卿，以將作監致仕烏昭為太府卿，以太常少卿致仕王禧為少府監，以秘書少監致仕段颙為將作監。

translations.literal: The late Regular Attendant Pei Yu was posthumously made Minister of Revenue; the late Guest of the Crown Prince Xiao Yuan was posthumously made Minister of Rites; Xue Renqian, retired Director of the Court of Imperial Granaries, was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; Wu Zhao, retired Director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction, was made Director of the Imperial Treasury; Wang Xi, retired Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Director of the Imperial Workshops; Duan Yong, retired Vice Director of the Secretariat Archive, was made Director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction.
translations.idiomatic: The late Regular Attendant Pei Yu was posthumously made Minister of Revenue; the late Guest of the Crown Prince Xiao Yuan was posthumously made Minister of Rites; Xue Renqian, retired Director of the Court of Imperial Granaries, was appointed Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; Wu Zhao, retired Director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction, was made Director of the Imperial Treasury; Wang Xi, retired Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Director of the Imperial Workshops; and Duan Yong, retired Vice Director of the Secretariat Archive, was appointed Director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction.

sentences.zh: 自仁謙而下，並依前致仕。

translations.literal: From Renqian downward, all continued in their former retirement status.
translations.idiomatic: From Renqian downward, all continued in retirement as before.

sentences.zh: 詔沿淮州縣軍鎮，今後自守疆土，不得縱一人一騎擅入淮南地分。

translations.literal: An edict to the prefectures, counties, and military posts along the Huai: from now on they shall themselves guard their territories and must not allow even a single man or horse to enter the Huainan region on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the prefectures, counties, and military posts along the Huai ordered that hereafter they guard their own territories and must not allow even a single man or horse to enter the Huainan region without authorization.

sentences.zh: 己卯，潞州奏，涉縣所擒河東將士二百餘人，部送赴闕。

translations.literal: On jimao, Lu Prefecture reported that more than two hundred Hedong soldiers captured in She County were escorted to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Lu Prefecture reported that more than two hundred Hedong soldiers captured in She County had been escorted to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔給衫袴巾屨，放歸本土。

translations.literal: An edict gave them shirts, trousers, headcloths, and shoes, and released them to return to their native regions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict provided them with shirts, trousers, headcloths, and shoes and released them to return home.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鎮州武行德移鎮許州，何福進移鎮鎮州。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wu Xingde of Zhen Prefecture was transferred to Xu Prefecture; He Fujin was transferred to Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wu Xingde of Zhen Prefecture was transferred to Xu Prefecture, and He Fujin was transferred to Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以襄州節度副使郭令圖為宗正卿。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Guo Lingtu, Vice Military Commissioner of Xiang Prefecture, was made Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Guo Lingtu, Vice Military Commissioner of Xiang Prefecture, was appointed Director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「故蘇逢吉、劉銖，頃在漢朝，與朕同事。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The late Su Fengji and Liu Zhu, who were recently in the Han dynasty, served together with Us.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The late Su Fengji and Liu Zhu once served with Us in the Han court.

sentences.zh: 朕自平禍亂，不念仇讎，尋示優宏，與全家屬。

translations.literal: Since We pacified the calamities and disorder, We have not borne old enmities in mind; shortly afterward We showed generous favor to their entire families.
translations.idiomatic: Since We pacified the turmoil, We have not dwelt on old enmities and soon showed generous favor to their entire families.

sentences.zh: 尚以幼稚無托，衣食是艱，將行矜恤之恩，俾獲生存之路，報怨以德，非我負人。

translations.literal: Still, their young and helpless had no support, and food and clothing were difficult; We shall extend compassionate favor so that they may obtain a path to survival; repaying enmity with virtue—We have not failed others.
translations.idiomatic: Yet their young and helpless still lack support and struggle for food and clothing. We shall extend compassionate favor so that they may find a way to survive. To repay enmity with virtue is not to fail others—it is to fulfill Our duty.

sentences.zh: 賜逢吉骨肉洛京莊宅各一，賜劉銖骨肉陜州莊宅各一。

translations.literal: We bestow on Fengji's kin one estate in the Luoyang capital each, and on Liu Zhu's kin one estate in Shaan Prefecture each.
translations.idiomatic: We bestow on Fengji's kin one estate in the Luoyang capital, and on Liu Zhu's kin one estate in Shaan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 」己丑，幸南莊。

translations.literal: " On jichou, the Emperor visited the Southern Estate.
translations.idiomatic: " On jichou, the Emperor visited the Southern Estate.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，唐故郇國公李從益追封許王，唐明宗淑妃王氏追贈賢妃。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Li Congyi, former Duke of Xun of Tang, was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Xu; Wang, the Pure Consort of Tang Emperor Mingzong, was posthumously made Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Li Congyi, former Duke of Xun of Tang, was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Xu; and Wang, the Pure Consort of Tang Emperor Mingzong, was posthumously made Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔：「諸道節度副使、行軍司馬、兩京少尹、留守判官，並許差定當直，人力不得過十五人；

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict: "For military vice commissioners of all circuits, field marshals, junior prefects of the two capitals, and military commissioners' judicial reviewers, each is permitted to assign fixed duty attendants, and manpower shall not exceed fifteen persons;
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, an edict said, "For military vice commissioners of all circuits, field marshals, junior prefects of the two capitals, and military commissioners' judicial reviewers, each may assign fixed duty attendants, but manpower shall not exceed fifteen persons;

sentences.zh: 諸府少尹、書記、支使、防禦團練副使，不得過十人；

translations.literal: for junior prefects, secretaries, branch commissioners, and defense and militia training vice commissioners of the various prefectures, it shall not exceed ten persons;
translations.idiomatic: for junior prefects, secretaries, branch commissioners, and defense and militia training vice commissioners of the various prefectures, the limit is ten persons;

sentences.zh: 節度推官、防卸團練軍事判官，不得過七人，逐處系帳收管。

translations.literal: for military commissioners' judicial examiners and defense and militia training military judicial reviewers, it shall not exceed seven persons; in each place they are to be registered and kept on the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: for military commissioners' judicial examiners and defense and militia training military judicial reviewers, the limit is seven persons; in each place they are to be registered and kept on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 此外如敢額外影占人戶，其本官當行朝典。

translations.literal: Beyond this, if anyone dares to take extra households under concealed protection, the official concerned shall be subject to court punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond this, if any official dares to take extra households under concealed protection, he shall be subject to court punishment.

sentences.zh: 」先是，漢隱帝時，有人上言：「州府從事令錄，皆請料錢，自合雇人驅使，不合差遣百姓丁戶。

translations.literal: " Previously, in the time of the Han Hidden Emperor, someone submitted a memorial saying: "The prefectural and circuit staff and recorders all receive stipend money and ought themselves to hire persons to serve them; they should not requisition commoners' corvée households.
translations.idiomatic: " Previously, during the reign of the Han Hidden Emperor, someone submitted a memorial saying, "The prefectural and circuit staff and recorders all receive stipend money and ought to hire their own attendants; they should not requisition commoners' corvée households.

sentences.zh: 」秉政者然之，乃下詔州府從事令錄，本處先差職役，並放歸農。

translations.literal: " Those holding power approved this, and so an edict was issued that the prefectural and circuit staff and recorders' locally requisitioned service duties were all released back to farming.
translations.idiomatic: " Those in power approved this, and an edict was issued ordering that service duties previously requisitioned from prefectural and circuit staff and recorders be released so that the men could return to farming.

sentences.zh: 自是官吏有獨行趨府縣者，帝頗知之，故有是命。

translations.literal: From this time there were officials who went alone to prefectures and counties, and the Emperor was quite aware of this; therefore there was this order.
translations.idiomatic: From that time officials had been going to prefectures and counties unaccompanied, which the Emperor well knew; hence this order.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰朔，詔沿淮州縣，許淮南人就淮北糴易糇糧，時淮南饑故也。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renchen, the first day of the month, an edict to the prefectures and counties along the Huai permitted people of Huainan to come to the north of the Huai to buy and exchange grain provisions, because Huainan was suffering famine at the time.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the first day of the fourth month of summer, an edict to the prefectures and counties along the Huai permitted people of Huainan to cross to the north bank to buy grain, because Huainan was then suffering famine.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以夫人董氏為德妃，仍令所司備禮冊命。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Lady Dong was made Virtuous Consort, and the responsible offices were further ordered to prepare the rites of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Lady Dong was made Virtuous Consort, and the responsible offices were ordered to prepare the rites of formal investiture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改侍衛馬步軍軍額。

translations.literal: On jihai, the designations of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies were changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the designations of the Palace Guard horse and foot armies were changed.

sentences.zh: 馬軍舊稱護聖，今改為龍捷；

translations.literal: The horse army was formerly called Guard of the Sage; it is now changed to Dragon Valiant;
translations.idiomatic: The horse army, formerly called Guard of the Sage, was renamed Dragon Valiant;

sentences.zh: 步軍舊稱奉國，今改為虎捷。

translations.literal: the foot army was formerly called Serving the State; it is now changed to Tiger Valiant.
translations.idiomatic: the foot army, formerly called Serving the State, was renamed Tiger Valiant.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔唐莊宗、明宗、晉高祖三處陵寢，各有守陵宮人，並放逐便。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict regarding the three mausoleum sites of Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong, Emperor Mingzong, and the Jin High Ancestor: each had palace women guarding the tombs, and all were released and dismissed as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict regarding the three mausoleum sites of Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong, Emperor Mingzong, and the Jin High Ancestor ordered that all palace women assigned to guard the tombs be released.

sentences.zh: 如願在陵所者，依舊供給。

translations.literal: If they wished to remain at the mausoleum sites, they were to be supplied as before.
translations.idiomatic: Those who wished to remain at the mausoleum sites were to be supplied as before.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，相州張彥成移鎮鄧州，折從阮移鎮滑州，李筠移鎮相州。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Zhang Yancheng of Xiang Prefecture was transferred to Deng Prefecture; Zhe Congruan was transferred to Hua Prefecture; Li Yun was transferred to Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Zhang Yancheng of Xiang Prefecture was transferred to Deng Prefecture; Zhe Congruan was transferred to Hua Prefecture; and Li Yun was transferred to Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙午，亳州防卸使王重裔卒。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Wang Chongyi, Commissioner of Defense of Bo Prefecture, died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wang Chongyi, Commissioner of Defense of Bo Prefecture, died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸南莊。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Emperor visited the Southern Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Emperor visited the Southern Estate.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，皇第四女封壽安公主。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the fourth imperial daughter was enfeoffed as Princess of Shou'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the fourth imperial daughter was enfeoffed as Princess of Shou'an.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，故許州節度使劉信追封蔡王。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Liu Xin, former Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Cai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Liu Xin, former Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Cai.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「牧守之任，委遇非輕，分憂之務既同，制祿之數宜等。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict said: "The responsibility of prefects and defenders is no light commission; since the task of sharing cares is the same, the regulated salary amounts ought to be equal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, an edict said, "The responsibility of prefects and defenders is no light commission. Since their charge of sharing the realm's burdens is the same, their regulated salaries ought to be equal.

sentences.zh: 自前有富庶之郡，請給則優，或邊侄之州，俸料素薄。

translations.literal: From before, wealthy and prosperous commanderies received generous allotments when they requested them, while some border regions' prefectures had always had thin salaries.
translations.idiomatic: Previously wealthy commanderies received generous allotments when they requested them, while some border prefectures had always had thin salaries.

sentences.zh: 以至遷除之際，擬議亦難，既論資敘之高低，又患祿秩之升降。

translations.literal: Thus at the time of transfers and appointments, deliberation was also difficult, since one had to consider both the high and low of seniority and rank and also worry about the rise and fall of salary grades.
translations.idiomatic: At the time of transfers and appointments, deliberation was therefore difficult, for one had to weigh seniority and rank while also worrying about the rise and fall of salary grades.

sentences.zh: 所宜分多益寡，均利同恩，冀無黨無偏，以勸勛效。

translations.literal: What is fitting is to take from the many and add to the few, equalize benefits and share grace alike, hoping for no factions and no partiality, in order to encourage meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to take from the abundant and supplement the meager, equalize benefits and share grace alike, and hope for neither faction nor favoritism, so as to encourage meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 今定諸防禦使料錢二百貫，祿粟一百石，食鹽五石，馬十匹草粟，元隨三十人衣糧；

translations.literal: Now it is fixed that all defense commissioners receive two hundred strings of stipend money, one hundred piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt for food, fodder grain for ten horses, and clothing provisions for thirty original followers;
translations.idiomatic: It is now fixed that all defense commissioners receive two hundred strings of stipend money, one hundred piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, fodder for ten horses, and provisions for thirty personal attendants;

sentences.zh: 團練使一百五十貫，祿粟七十石，鹽五石，馬十匹，元隨三十人；

translations.literal: militia training commissioners one hundred fifty strings, seventy piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, ten horses, thirty original followers;
translations.idiomatic: militia training commissioners one hundred fifty strings, seventy piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, ten horses, and thirty personal attendants;

sentences.zh: 刺史一百貫，祿粟五十石，鹽五石，馬五匹，元隨二十人」云。

translations.literal: prefects one hundred strings, fifty piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, five horses, twenty original followers," it said.
translations.idiomatic: and prefects one hundred strings, fifty piculs of salary grain, five piculs of salt, five horses, and twenty personal attendants," the edict concluded.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，尚書左丞田敏使契丹回。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, returned from his mission to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, returned from his mission to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 契丹主兀欲遣。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler Wuyu had sent

sentences.zh: 使耨姑報命，並獻碧玉金塗銀裹鞍勒各一副，弓矢、器仗、貂裘等，土產馬三十匹、土產漢馬十匹。

translations.literal: the envoy Nougu to report back, and also presented one set each of jade-inlaid saddles and bridles with gold coating and silver wrapping, bows and arrows, weapons and gear, sable furs, and the like, thirty native horses and ten native Han horses.
translations.idiomatic: the envoy Nougu to deliver his response, together with one set each of jade-inlaid saddles and bridles with gold coating and silver wrapping, bows and arrows, weapons and gear, sable furs, and the like, thirty native horses and ten native Han-bred horses.

sentences.zh: 庚申，帝為故貴妃張氏舉哀於舊宮，輟視朝三日。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the Emperor held mourning for the late Noble Consort Zhang at the former palace and suspended court audiences for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Emperor held mourning for the late Noble Consort Zhang at her former palace and suspended court audiences for three days.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，司空致仕盧文紀卒。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Lu Wenji, retired Minister of Works, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Lu Wenji, retired Minister of Works, died.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯朔，不視朝，以漢隱帝梓宮在殯故也。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinmao, the first day of the month, the court was not held, because the Han Hidden Emperor's coffin was still in temporary interment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the first day of the sixth month, the Emperor did not hold court, because the Han Hidden Emperor's coffin was still in temporary interment.

sentences.zh: 甲午，百僚上表，請以七月二十八日皇帝降聖日為永壽節，從之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the hundred officials submitted a memorial requesting that the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month, the day the Emperor descended as sage, be made the Everlasting Longevity Festival, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the hundred officials submitted a memorial requesting that the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month, the Emperor's birthday, be established as the Everlasting Longevity Festival, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 邢州大雨霖。

translations.literal: Xing Prefecture had heavy prolonged rain.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Prefecture suffered heavy prolonged rains.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太常少卿劉悅上漢少帝謚曰隱皇帝，陵曰穎陵，從之。

translations.literal: On jihai, Liu Yue, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, submitted that the Han Lesser Emperor's posthumous title should be Hidden Emperor and his mausoleum Ying Mausoleum, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liu Yue, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, proposed the posthumous title Hidden Emperor and the mausoleum name Ying Mausoleum for the Han Lesser Emperor, and the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以樞密使王峻為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎、同平章事、監修國史，充樞密使；

translations.literal: On xinhai, Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Associate Counselor, and Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, continuing as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Associate Counselor, and Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, while retaining his post as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以樞密副使、尚書兵部侍郎範質為中書侍郎、同平章事，充集賢殿大學士；

translations.literal: Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of War in the Secretariat, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate Counselor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhi, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Minister of War in the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate Counselor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎、判三司李穀為中書侍郎、同平章事，判三司。

translations.literal: Li Gu, Vice Minister of Revenue and Administrator of the Three Departments, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate Counselor, and continued to administer the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu, Vice Minister of Revenue and Administrator of the Three Departments, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Counselor while continuing to administer the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 司徒兼侍中、監修國史竇貞固，司空兼中書侍郎、同平章事、集賢殿大學士蘇禹珪，並罷相守本官。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Education and concurrent Palace Attendant and Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, and Su Yugui, Minister of Works, concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate Counselor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies, were both removed as chief ministers and retained their original offices.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Education and concurrent Palace Attendant and Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, and Su Yugui, Minister of Works, concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate Counselor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Gathering Worthies, were both dismissed as chief ministers and retained their original offices.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸西莊。

translations.literal: On renzi, the Emperor visited the Western Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Emperor visited the Western Estate.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔宰臣範質參知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict made Chief Minister Fan Zhi a participant in the affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, an edict appointed Chief Minister Fan Zhi to participate in the affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 鄴都、洺、滄、貝等州大雨霖。

translations.literal: Ye Capital, Luo, Cang, Bei, and other prefectures had heavy prolonged rain.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Capital, Luo, Cang, Bei, and other prefectures suffered heavy prolonged rains.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，西京奏，新授宗正卿郭令圖卒。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Western Capital reported that Guo Lingtu, newly appointed Director of the Imperial Clan Court, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Western Capital reported that Guo Lingtu, newly appointed Director of the Imperial Clan Court, had died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以尚書左丞顏衎為兵部侍郎，充端明殿學士；

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yan Kan, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of War and appointed Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yan Kan, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Minister of War and Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity;

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使翟光鄴兼樞密副使。

translations.literal: Zhai Guangye, Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat, was made concurrent Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Guangye, Commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat, was appointed concurrent Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉朔，帝被袞冕，禦崇元殿，授太廟四室寶冊於中書令馮道等，赴西京行禮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou, the first day of the month, the Emperor donned his ceremonial robes and cap, took the throne in the Hall of Lofty Primordium, and conferred the precious registers of the four chambers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple upon Chief Director Feng Dao and others, who proceeded to the Western Capital to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the first day of the seventh month of autumn, the Emperor donned his ceremonial robes and cap, took the throne in the Hall of Lofty Primordium, and conferred the precious registers of the four chambers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple upon Chief Director Feng Dao and others, who then proceeded to the Western Capital to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，尚書左丞田敏兼判國子監事。

translations.literal: On guihai, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made concurrent Administrator of the Directorate of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was appointed concurrent Administrator of the Directorate of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以卸史中丞於德辰為尚書右丞，以秘書監邊光範為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Yu Dechen, Censor-in-Chief, was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; Bian Guangfan, Director of the Secretariat Archive, was made Guest of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yu Dechen, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; Bian Guangfan, Director of the Secretariat Archive, was made Guest of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書張昭為太子賓客，以其子秉為陽翟簿，犯法抵罪，昭詣閣待罪，詔釋之，乃左授此官。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhao, Minister of Revenue, was made Guest of the Crown Prince; because his son Bing, Registrar of Yangdi, had violated the law and been sentenced, Zhao came to the palace gate to await punishment; an edict released him, and he was then demoted to this office on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao, Minister of Revenue, was appointed Guest of the Crown Prince. His son Bing, Registrar of Yangdi, had violated the law and been sentenced; Zhao came to the palace gate to await punishment. An edict released him, and he was then demoted to this post.

sentences.zh: 壬申，史官賈緯等以所撰《晉高祖實錄》三十卷、《少帝實錄》二十卷上之。

translations.literal: On renshen, the historiographers Jia Wei and others presented the thirty juan of the Veritable Records of the Jin High Ancestor and the twenty juan of the Veritable Records of the Lesser Emperor that they had compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the historiographers Jia Wei and others presented the thirty-juan Veritable Records of the Jin High Ancestor and the twenty-juan Veritable Records of the Lesser Emperor that they had compiled.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸宰臣王峻第。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the Emperor visited the residence of Chief Minister Wang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Emperor visited the residence of Chief Minister Wang Jun.

sentences.zh: 己丑，鎮州奏，破河東賊軍於平山縣西，斬首五百級。

translations.literal: On jichou, Zhen Prefecture reported that it had defeated the Hedong rebel army west of Pingshan County and beheaded five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Zhen Prefecture reported that it had defeated the Hedong rebel army west of Pingshan County and taken five hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 是日，太常卿邊蔚奏，議改郊廟舞名，事具《樂志》。

translations.literal: That day, Bian Wei, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, reported a proposal to change the names of the suburban and temple dances; the matter is fully recorded in the Treatise on Music.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, Bian Wei, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, reported a proposal to change the names of the suburban and temple dances; the matter is fully recorded in the Treatise on Music.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，漢隱帝梓宮發引，帝詣太平宮臨奠，詔群臣出祖於西郊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinmao, the Han Hidden Emperor's coffin was sent forth; the Emperor went to the Taiping Palace to offer libation; an edict ordered the ministers to escort it forth at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the eighth month, the Han Hidden Emperor's coffin was sent forth. The Emperor went to the Taiping Palace to offer libation and ordered the ministers to escort it forth at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 是歲，幽州饑，流人散入滄州界。

translations.literal: That year, You Prefecture suffered famine, and refugees scattered into the borders of Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year You Prefecture suffered famine, and refugees scattered into the territory of Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔流人至者，口給鬥粟，仍給無主土田，令取便種蒔，放免差稅。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for refugees who arrived, each person was to be given a dou of grain, and ownerless land was also to be granted, allowing them to plant and sow as convenient, with corvée and taxes remitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that each arriving refugee be given a dou of grain per person, that ownerless land also be granted for convenient planting, and that corvée and taxes be remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸已，虎入西京修行寺傷人，市民殺之。

translations.literal: On guisi, a tiger entered the Xixing Monastery in the Western Capital and wounded people; the townspeople killed it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, a tiger entered the Xixing Monastery in the Western Capital and wounded people; townspeople killed it.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸班荊館。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the Emperor visited the Banjing Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Emperor visited the Banjing Lodge.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，契丹遣幽州牙將曹繼筠來歸故晉中書令趙瑩之喪，詔贈太傅，仍賜其子絹五百匹，以備喪事，歸葬於華陰故裏。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Khitan sent the You Prefecture military officer Cao Jijun to return the remains of the former Jin Vice Director Zhao Ying; an edict posthumously made him Grand Tutor and also bestowed five hundred bolts of silk on his son for funeral preparations; he was buried in his native place in Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Khitan sent the You Prefecture military officer Cao Jijun to return the remains of the former Jin Vice Director Zhao Ying. An edict posthumously made Zhao Grand Tutor and bestowed five hundred bolts of silk on his son for the funeral; he was buried in his native place in Huayin.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸西莊。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Emperor visited the Western Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Emperor visited the Western Estate.

sentences.zh: 壬子，晉州王晏移鎮徐州，滄州王景移鎮河中，定州孫方簡移鎮華州，永興郭從義移鎮許州，貝州王繼宏移鎮河陽，李暉移鎮滄州。

translations.literal: On renzi, Wang Yan of Jin Prefecture was transferred to Xu Prefecture; Wang Jing of Cang Prefecture was transferred to Hezhong; Sun Fangjian of Ding Prefecture was transferred to Hua Prefecture; Guo Congyi of Yongxing was transferred to Xu Prefecture; Wang Jihong of Bei Prefecture was transferred to Heyang; Li Hui was transferred to Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wang Yan of Jin Prefecture was transferred to Xu Prefecture; Wang Jing of Cang Prefecture to Hezhong; Sun Fangjian of Ding Prefecture to Hua Prefecture; Guo Congyi of Yongxing to Xu Prefecture; Wang Jihong of Bei Prefecture to Heyang; and Li Hui to Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以許州節度使武行德為西京留守，滑州折從阮移鎮陜州，河中扈彥珂移鎮滑州，陜州李洪信移鎮永興，華州王饒移鎮貝州，徐州王彥超移鎮晉州。

translations.literal: Wu Xingde, Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made Western Capital Military Commissioner; Zhe Congruan of Hua Prefecture was transferred to Shan Prefecture; Hu Yanke of Hezhong was transferred to Hua Prefecture; Li Hongxin of Shan Prefecture was transferred to Yongxing; Wang Rao of Hua Prefecture was transferred to Bei Prefecture; Wang Yanchao of Xu Prefecture was transferred to Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xingde, Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was appointed Western Capital Military Commissioner; Zhe Congruan of Hua Prefecture was transferred to Shan Prefecture; Hu Yanke of Hezhong to Hua Prefecture; Li Hongxin of Shan Prefecture to Yongxing; Wang Rao of Hua Prefecture to Bei Prefecture; and Wang Yanchao of Xu Prefecture to Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，尚食李氏等宮官八人並封縣君，司記劉氏等六人並封郡夫人，尚宮皇甫氏等三人並封國夫人。

translations.literal: On bingchen, eight palace officials including Li of the Office of Imperial Food were all enfeoffed as Ladies of a County; six including Liu of the Office of Records were all enfeoffed as Ladies of a Commandery; three including Huangfu of the Palace Secretariat Office were all enfeoffed as Ladies of a State.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, eight palace officials including Li of the Office of Imperial Food were all enfeoffed as Ladies of a County; six including Liu of the Office of Records as Ladies of a Commandery; and three including Huangfu of the Palace Secretariat Office as Ladies of a State.

sentences.zh: 唐制有內官、宮官，各有司存，更不加郡國之號，近代加之，非舊典也。

translations.literal: The Tang system had inner officials and palace officials, each with their own offices and functions, and did not further add titles of commanderies or states; recent times have added them—this is not the old standard.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang system, inner officials and palace officials each had their own offices and functions, and were not further given commandery or state titles. Recent times have added such titles, which is not the old standard.

sentences.zh: 以易州刺史孫行友為定州留後。

translations.literal: Sun Xingyou, Prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made Military Governor-in-Residence of Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Xingyou, Prefect of Yi Prefecture, was appointed Military Governor-in-Residence of Ding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊午，故夫人柴氏追立為皇后，仍令所司定謚，備禮冊命。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the late Lady Chai was posthumously established as Empress; the responsible offices were further ordered to fix her posthumous title and prepare the rites of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the late Lady Chai was posthumously established as Empress; the responsible offices were ordered to fix her posthumous title and prepare the rites of formal investiture.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申朔，帝詣太平宮起居漢太后。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengshen, the first day of the month, the Emperor went to the Taiping Palace to inquire after the Han Empress Dowager's health.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the first day of the ninth month, the Emperor went to the Taiping Palace to inquire after the Han Empress Dowager's health.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，故夫人楊氏追贈淑妃，仍令所司擇日備禮冊命。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the late Lady Yang was posthumously made Pure Consort; the responsible offices were further ordered to choose a day and prepare the rites of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the late Lady Yang was posthumously made Pure Consort; the responsible offices were ordered to choose a day and prepare the rites of formal investiture.

sentences.zh: 故皇第五女追封永寧公主。

translations.literal: The late fifth imperial daughter was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: The late fifth imperial daughter was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Yongning.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，定州奏，契丹永康王烏裕為部下所殺。

translations.literal: On guihai, Ding Prefecture reported that Wuyu, the Khitan Prince of Yongkang, had been killed by his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Ding Prefecture reported that Wuyu, the Khitan Prince of Yongkang, had been killed by his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以前耀州團練使武廷翰為太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Wu Tinghan, former Militia Training Commissioner of Yao Prefecture, was granted retirement as Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wu Tinghan, former Militia Training Commissioner of Yao Prefecture, was granted retirement as Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 丙子，諸道兵馬都元帥、兩浙節度使、檢校太師、尚書令、中書令、吳越國王錢俶加天下兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Qian Chu, Commander-in-Chief of All Circuits' Armies and Horses, Military Commissioner of the Two Zhe Circuits, Inspector-General of the Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, Chief Director of the Secretariat, and King of Wuyue, was further made Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Qian Chu, Commander-in-Chief of All Circuits' Armies and Horses, Military Commissioner of the Two Zhe Circuits, Inspector-General of the Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, Chief Director of the Secretariat, and King of Wuyue, was further made Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，中書舍人劉濤責授少府少監，分司西京，坐遣男頊代草制詞也。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Liu Tao, Secretariat Drafter, was demoted and appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Workshops, assigned to the Western Capital branch, because he had sent his son Xu to draft edicts in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Liu Tao, Secretariat Drafter, was demoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Workshops and assigned to the Western Capital branch for having sent his son Xu to draft edicts in his place.

sentences.zh: 監察御史劉頊責授復州司戶，坐代父草制也。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Liu Xu was demoted and appointed Revenue Clerk of Fu Prefecture for having drafted edicts in place of his father.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Liu Xu was demoted to Revenue Clerk of Fu Prefecture for having drafted edicts in his father's place.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人楊昭儉解官放逐私便，以多在假告，不親其職也。

translations.literal: Yang Zhaojian, Secretariat Drafter, was removed from office and banished for private convenience, because he was often on leave and did not attend to his duties.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhaojian, Secretariat Drafter, was removed from office and banished for private reasons, because he was often on leave and did not attend to his duties.
